name: Nightfall

components.pose: She stands at the edge of her homeland as the last light goes, with dancing flame, embers and sparks gathered low in one open hand like a lantern that lights her face, looking to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: Dancing flame, embers and sparks light the land around her and {{MAGIC}} light glows warm against the dark.

notes: REALM SERIES: Nightfall in her fire homeland (night); realistic, from realms/fire-lands and backgrounds/fantasy/country/fire.
